name: PhysStudio (physics-based Gaussian splatting toolbox)
summary: Open-source toolbox from ZJU3DV that unifies ~24 physics simulation methods on 3D Gaussian splat scenes (snow, rain, lava, fire, wind, ice melting, fluids, sand, plant growth, magnetism, bubbles, robot pouring) behind one CLI, with fetchable pretrained scenes. Useful for VFX look-dev and dynamic 3DGS research.

access.notes: Original code Apache-2.0; third-party components keep MIT/BSD/MPL; fetched scenes keep upstream terms (e.g. CC BY 4.0 SuperSplat, CC0 Poly Haven, research datasets). Check each asset before commercial use.

procedure: Follow INSTALL.md: Linux, Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.4.0 cu118, Warp 1.6.2, gsplat 1.5.3, NVIDIA GPU + CUDA toolkit
Fetch scenes: python -m physstudio fetch <name> (or all), see ASSETS.md
Run e.g.: python -m physstudio run enlivening bread --gpu 0

verdict.why: Credible lab (ZJU3DV), clear Apache-2.0 code license, broad method coverage in one CLI. Needs an NVIDIA GPU and Linux setup; asset licenses vary, so commercial use is restricted. Young repo (28 stars).
